root_cause: The frame-record fallback resolved Auto view intents at the cached record's sampling scale, allowing cached density to override a changed viewport.
correction: Render and replay resolve changed intents through the same retained per-destination ViewerResolutionPolicy using validated frame descriptions. Exact unchanged-intent replay remains graph-free. Existing ROI, force-full-frame coverage, explicit resolution modes and Auto hysteresis are unchanged.
api_changes: ViewerSession::replay(ViewIntent, revision, resolution, destination) now requires the destination's existing ViewerResolutionPolicy.
Removed the obsolete resolveViewDemand fixed-density entry point; resolveViewIntent owns all demand arithmetic.

red_green.before: Shrinking a 64x48 view to 8x6 incorrectly replayed and displayed a 64x48 cached raster at scale 1 instead of 16x12 at scale 4; six assertions failed.
red_green.after: Passes, including added checks for retained Auto hysteresis and reuse of the original larger cached sibling.

native_scenario.source: command-authored 2160x540 constcolor graph, using the existing generated-frame native verification seam
native_scenario.pixel_check: Native window grab contains the expected red image after range-cache replay; cached and grown captures visually inspected.
native_scenario.geometry: Corresponding environment-*.json files record actual compositor-constrained geometry and sampling scale.

build.warning: Existing minizip-ng linker warning about mktemp.

verification_scope: Focused GPU and native checks only; no repeat full suite, release or sanitizer run. No changes to QML geometry, gestures, full-frame coverage semantics, resolution thresholds or pre-existing user edits.
out_of_scope_observation: Attempts to use literal plate.####.png and plate.####.exr paths in the native Read fixture failed to open those pattern paths. Sequence-path behavior was not diagnosed or changed; final native range verification uses the existing generated-frame seam. The GPU session regression uses real decoded clip media.
